Fixed `TOUCH` under `CLIENT NO-TOUCH ON` when invoked from scripts.

- Updated `src/db.c` to identify the currently executing nested script command through `scriptGetClient()` rather than the outer `EVAL`/`FCALL` command.
- `TOUCH` now correctly bypasses no-touch suppression in scripts, while ordinary script reads continue respecting no-touch mode.
- Kept explicit `LOOKUP_NOTOUCH` behavior unchanged.

```sh
make -j2 && ./runtest --single unit/introspection-2
```
